template: Prohibition on the Sale or Use of Coordinated Pricing Algorithms to Set Rents or Manage Occupancy Levels applies to this address. Source: Berkeley Municipal Code Chapter 13.63 (§§ 13.63.030, 13.63.040), as amended by Ordinance No. 7,992-N.S.; as of 2026-01-02. Not legal advice.
